command: docker exec -i supabase-db psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v VERBOSITY=sqlstate -U supabase_admin -d postgres
sql: BEGIN READ ONLY; SET LOCAL statement_timeout='5s'; SELECT jsonb_build_object('database',current_database(),'operator',current_user,'newFunctions', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='academy' AND p.proname IN ('inspect_staff_role_audit','inspect_course_entitlement_audit')),'auditTables',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',c.relname,'owner',r.rolname,'rls',c.relrowsecurity,'forceRls',c.relforcerowsecurity)) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=c.relowner WHERE n.nspname='academy' AND c.relname IN ('staff_role_audit','course_entitlement_audit')),'existingInspectors',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',p.proname,'owner',r.rolname,'securityDefiner',p.prosecdef)) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=p.proowner WHERE n.nspname='academy' AND p.proname IN ('inspect_staff_role_assignment','inspect_course_entitlement'))); ROLLBACK;
